⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Outstanding experience from start to finish with DG Home Improvement. Dennis and Kirill did an amazing job correcting issues left by previous contractors and transforming our kitchen and several other rooms. They were professional, reliable, detail-oriented, and genuinely cared about the quality of their work.

What I appreciated most was their honesty and commitment to getting everything done right rather than taking shortcuts. The final result exceeded my expectations, and my home finally feels complete.

Highly recommend this company to anyone looking for quality craftsmanship and trustworthy professionals. Thank you, Dennis and Kirill!

reviews_captured_by_me.text: We used DG Home Improvement for remodeling our bathroom by installing the shower in place of the old bathtub. The team made outstanding job. We are highly impressed with their professionalism and the quality of our new bathroom. Our neighbors were also impressed by design of our remodeled bathroom. Great quality, great team to work with. Thank you!

We had a great experience working with Denis and his team on our balcony and deck project. From the very beginning, they demonstrated a highly professional approach in every aspect of the work. The project started with a quick and efficient demolition, and throughout the process the team handled several challenges with professionalism and clear expertise.

What stood out most was their attention to detail and commitment to doing the job correctly without cutting corners. Communication was clear, the work was well organized, and the quality of craftsmanship was evident at every stage of the project.

The final result truly speaks for itself — the balcony and deck turned out beautifully and exceeded our expectations. We are extremely pleased with the outcome and would highly recommend Dennis and his team to anyone looking for a contractor who takes pride in their work and delivers high-quality results with a professional approach.
